name: @qcksys/ao3tracker-native-kmp
description: Versioning anchor for the Kotlin Multiplatform app. Used by Changesets only — actual build is Gradle (./gradlew). Native version numbers live in composeApp/build.gradle.kts (Android versionName) and iosApp/Configuration/Config.xcconfig (MARKETING_VERSION) and must be bumped to match this value before each release.
